name: Cosmic Weaponry, Drawn
th: อาวุธเทพ วาดด้วยคณิต
note: Weapons of the gods drawn live with math: Indra's vajra, the Buddhist bell, lightning grown by the 1984 breakdown model, Mekhala and Ramasun's thunder clock, sky-axes and Tutankhamun's meteorite dagger, the discus and trident ground off the sun, Mjolnir's short handle and the Monkey King's staff
